purpose: Exact-fingerprint classification of Gitleaks findings from the HOY all-history secret audit. No secret/match values are stored here.

policy.rule: Only exact listed fingerprints may be treated as classified. Any new fingerprint fails the RT-005 gate.
policy.publishable_key_boundary: Supabase sb_publishable_ keys are intentionally public client identifiers. This does not relax RLS/GRANT/security requirements and does not apply to sb_secret_ or service_role credentials.

classifications.rationale: Deliberately fake high-entropy detector-health canary committed in the historical audit workflow; not an operational credential. The clean workflow constructs its canary only at runtime.
